propositions: A centralized metric registry must map each metric id to its lens, data source, confidence level, and compute function so the command is defined once and extensible without modification.
Metrics with no available data must return an Unavailable state carrying a reason and an ISO-formatted accruing_since timestamp rather than being absent from output.

Every metric value must carry source and confidence labels (source in {structural, git, sidecar, snapshot, backfill_classified}; confidence in {high, classified}) to enable downstream segregation of authoritative from classified/backfilled data.
The is_authoritative() helper must return False for backfill_classified source and exclude classified values from authoritative aggregations.
Registry entries must be validated such that all ids are unique and each entry has required fields: id, lens, source, and confidence.
